# Quiet Ruled Lines

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Fill thin, long green, blue or red ruling from the surrounding paper and keep the ink, without modifying source files.

| --- | --- |

| Category | transform |
| Uses a language model | no |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `colour` | string | auto | Which ruling colour; auto takes the colour with most ruling. One of: auto, green, blue, red, none. |
| `compression_quality` | integer | 90 | JPEG/WebP compression quality. |
| `inpaint_radius` | integer | 3 | — |
| `max_width` | integer | 3 | Ruling is thinner than this, in pixels. |
| `min_length` | number | 0.3 | Ruling is longer than this fraction of the page's side. |
| `output_dir` | string | — | Optional output directory. Defaults to a temp directory. |
| `output_format` | string | jpg | Derived image format. One of: jpg, png, tiff, webp. |
